versions.changelog:
- Updated the skill guide, tool reference, and run script.
- Removed skill-card.md.

- Standardizes committee verdict save flow: Coordinator variants must specify both provider and model name in `save_committee` for accurate transcript labeling and scorecard tracking.
- Updates protocol docs and SKILL.md instructions to clarify the above and avoid mixing verdicts/data when switching models.
- Removes outdated `skill-card.md`.
- Minor wording clarifications and touchups throughout documentation.
